UnitStatement: Test module focuses on DEL-08-06 state/comparison/handoff report sections.
Tests import build_state_comparison_handoff_report_sections, canonical_json, and diagnostics_for_report_sections from core.reporting.state_comparison_handoff_sections.

FORBIDDEN_OUTPUT_PHRASES enumerates authority terms (code-compliant, certified, sealed, authenticated, professional approval, external validation, engineering acceptance) that must not appear in output.
boundary() fixture asserts human_review_required True and all software_makes_*_claim / professional_reliance / external_validation flags False.
Invented model_state fixture carries analysis_status MECHANICS_SOLVED and HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Model state immutability_policy declares snapshot_is_read_only True.
test_sections_are_deterministic_and_represent_all_required_families asserts canonical_json output is identical across two builds (determinism).
Report sections record carries deliverable_id DEL-08-06 and package_id PKG-08.
State-run sections must contain exactly section_kind analysis_run_record and model_state_record.
Handoff sections must contain section_kinds export_workflow_record, external_prover_metadata, and handoff_package_manifest.
test_sections_preserve_ids_hashes_warnings_assumptions_units_and_review_state verifies ids, hashes, warnings, assumptions, unit context, and review state are preserved in output sections.
Export section unsupported_target_records must drop the private_payload field (private payload not propagated).

test_missing_source_values_become_explicit_findings_and_tbds: removing unit_system_ref and provenance yields diagnostic SCH-SOURCE-VALUE-MISSING and unresolved TBDs for unit_context and source_provenance.

test_authority_claims_are_diagnosed_without_copying_claim_text: an approval boundary flag plus compliance/certified warning text yields SCH-SOFTWARE-AUTHORITY-FLAG-BLOCKED and SCH-AUTHORITY-CLAIM-REJECTED without copying the claim text into output.
Rejected authority claim text is replaced with marker omitted_prohibited_authority_or_reliance_claim.
test_disallowed_analysis_status_is_diagnosed_and_not_emitted: status HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT yields SCH-ANALYSIS-STATUS-BLOCKED and is excluded from the emitted analysis_status list.
test_external_prover_execution_claim_is_out_of_scope: external_prover_executed True yields diagnostic SCH-EXTERNAL-PROVER-EXECUTION-OUT-OF-SCOPE.
test_numeric_comparison_deltas_need_units_and_dimensions: removing a delta dimension yields SCH-COMPARISON-DELTA-UNIT-MISSING and SCH-NUMERIC-UNIT-METADATA-MISSING.

test_boundary_flags_cannot_be_flipped_on_section_set: flipping human_review_required False and professional_reliance True yields SCH-HUMAN-REVIEW-NOT-REQUIRED-BLOCKED and SCH-SOFTWARE-AUTHORITY-FLAG-BLOCKED.

test_output_boundary_language_does_not_make_prohibited_claims_for_clean_sources: no FORBIDDEN_OUTPUT_PHRASES appear and all professional_boundary claim flags remain False with human_review_required True.
Test module focuses on DEL-17-06 stress-neutral CSV/JSON export packages.
Tests import build_stress_neutral_export_package, canonical_json, render_stress_neutral_csv, and write_stress_neutral_export_package from core.handoff.stress_neutral.
Stress-neutral hash values must match pattern sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}.
Stress-neutral CSV header is result_id,canonical_ref,row_kind,result_family,load_case_ref,station_ref,component_ref,value,unit,dimension,correlation_status.
FORBIDDEN_PAYLOAD_TEXT bars real-client, ASME-table, B31J, certified-by-OpenPipeStress, code-compliant, and professional-acceptance text from payloads.
test_fixture_and_builder_validate_against_schema validates fixture and builder output against stress_neutral_export.schema.json.
test_builder_is_deterministic_and_preserves_members asserts canonical_json determinism and deliverable_id DEL-17-06, package_status stress_neutral_export_package.
Export profile comparison_semantics is diagnostic_export_only_no_pass_fail and unit_policy is unit_and_dimension_required_per_row.
Package members must cover roles manifest, csv_text, result_rows, unit_system_disclosure, stable_id_map, loss_report, validation_report, and diagnostics.
Unit system disclosure declares conversion_performed False and protected_content_included False.
test_csv_and_json_rows_are_synchronized_and_ascii_safe asserts csv_text equals render_stress_neutral_csv(result_rows), matches the ASCII CSV fixture, and is ASCII-encodable.

test_missing_units_stable_ids_and_loss_report_are_blocking: empty unit, empty stable_id_map, and empty loss_report yield codes SN-UNIT-DIMENSION-MISSING, SN-STABLE-ID-MAP-MISSING, SN-LOSS-REPORT-MISSING with blocking severity and validation_status blocked.

test_privacy_and_authority_boundary_diagnostics_are_blocking: an authority profile label plus protected_payload_embedded yields SN-PRIVACY-BOUNDARY-VIOLATION and SN-PROFILE-AUTHORITY-TERM as blocking, with compliance and reliance flags False.

test_source_basis_refs_cover_result_export_run_and_comparison_contracts: source_basis_refs must include Deliverables DEL-08-04, DEL-14-02, DEL-14-05, DEL-17-02; omitting them yields SN-SOURCE-BASIS-REFS-MISSING and blocked validation.

test_writer_outputs_csv_and_sidecars asserts write_stress_neutral_export_package emits stress_neutral_results.csv plus manifest, result_rows, stable_id_map, loss_report, validation_report, and diagnostics JSON sidecars.
test_fixtures_contain_no_private_or_protected_payload_text asserts no FORBIDDEN_PAYLOAD_TEXT appears across fixture, source payload, and CSV.
Test module focuses on DEL-15-02 target mapping contract.
Tests import build_target_mapping_contract, canonical_json, and diagnostics_for_target_mapping_contract from core.handoff.target_mapping.
validate_contract checks the contract against target_mapping.schema.json via Draft202012Validator with no errors.

test_contract_is_deterministic_and_preserves_handoff_context asserts canonical_json determinism, deliverable_id DEL-15-02, preserved model_hash and units_manifest_ref, and unsupported flag human_review_required True with no blocking diagnostics.
test_unit_bearing_mapping_without_unit_metadata_is_blocked: null unit_metadata on a mapping yields TM-UNIT-METADATA-MISSING with blocking severity.
test_missing_context_and_untraceable_behavior_emit_diagnostics: empty source_context and an untraced unsupported behavior yield TM-SOURCE-CONTEXT-FIELD-MISSING and TM-AFFECTED-REFS-MISSING.
test_behavior_label_authority_wording_is_blocking_boundary_diagnostic: a certified behavior_label yields TM-PROHIBITED-AUTHORITY-TERM with blocking severity.

test_output_boundary_language_does_not_make_prohibited_claims: output excludes code-compliant, certified, sealed, authenticated, professional-approval, external-validation and software_makes_compliance_claim is False.
Test module provides stdlib checks for the unit system schema (units.schema.yaml).
CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS lists the allowed dimension ids including dimensionless, length, mass, time, temperature, force, pressure, stress, area, volume, density, stiffness variants, and TBD.
RETIRED_DIMENSIONS (temperature_difference, area_moment, stiffness) must not appear in the dimension enum.
REQUIRED_QUANTITY_FIELDS requires quantity_id, quantity_kind, magnitude, unit_ref, dimension_id, unit_required, missing_unit_behavior, and provenance.
FORBIDDEN_DEFAULT_TERMS bars assume/assumed zero/unity, defaults-to, default-value, fallback/implicit default, and silently from schema text.
check_schema_contract asserts schema draft 2020-12, additionalProperties False, and no default key anywhere in the schema.

Unit schema required root includes schema_version, unit_system, dimension_records, quantity_records, conversion_declarations, dimension_checks, operation_rules, test_obligations, open_decisions, and diagnostics.
DimensionId enum must equal CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS and share no members with RETIRED_DIMENSIONS.
DimensionVector requires base dimensions length, mass, time, temperature, angle, electric_current, substance_amount, and luminous_intensity.
QuantityRecord missing_unit_behavior enum is diagnostic_blocking, diagnostic_warning, not_applicable_explicit_dimensionless, and TBD.
ConversionDeclaration requires conversion_id, source_unit_ref, target_unit_ref, dimension_id, transform_kind, factor_representation, provenance, and review_status.
OperationRule requires operation, compatibility_rule, unsupported_behavior, diagnostic_codes, and review_status.
OperationRule compatibility_rule enum includes same_dimension_required, derived_dimension_required, explicit_dimensionless_classification_required, and unsupported_until_decision.

OperationRule operation enum includes addition, subtraction, comparison, conversion, multiplication, division, power, dimensionless_classification, import_validation, export_validation, and rule_evaluation.
TestObligation requires test_id, test_kind, required_for, fixture_data_policy, gating_status, and evidence_ref.
TestObligation enums include test_kind conversion_gated_pending_constants, fixture_data_policy no_numeric_conversion_constants_until_approved, and gating_status blocked_pending_decision.
OpenDecision requires decision_id, topic, status, blocking_scope, required_before, owner, and notes.

OpenDecision topic enum includes unit_catalog, base_dimension_vector, dimensionless_classification, conversion_tolerance_policy, offset_temperature_semantics, gauge_absolute_pressure_semantics, and diagnostic_code_namespace.

UnitDiagnosticCode enum includes UNIT_MISSING, UNIT_UNKNOWN, UNIT_AMBIGUOUS, DIMENSION_MISMATCH, CONVERSION_UNSUPPORTED, DIMENSIONLESS_CLASSIFICATION_REQUIRED, PROTECTED_UNIT_DATA_SUSPECTED, and CONVERSION_TEST_GATED.
check_unit_fixture asserts the fixture satisfies required root fields and UnitSystemRecord requirements with storage_convention entered_units_preserved.
Fixture quantity record sets unit_required True and missing_unit_behavior diagnostic_blocking.
Fixture diagnostics include UNIT_MISSING and its dimension_checks[0] outcome is blocked.
Fixture open_decisions are all status open_TBD and conversion_declarations[0] transform_kind is unsupported_TBD.
Fixture conversion_gated_pending_constants test obligation has gating_status blocked_pending_decision.
check_jsonschema_validation validates schema document and fixture, skipping or noting when the jsonschema dependency is missing.
Test module provides focused checks for DEL-11-01 user-guide analysis status wording (docs/user_guide/index.md).
test_user_guide_lists_external_human_approval_status_without_software_claim asserts the user guide documents HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT.
User guide must describe HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT as an external human acceptance record tied to exact reviewed hashes, not emitted by the solver or rule-pack evaluator.
User guide must state the status is not software approval, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance determination.
Test module provides stdlib checks for the viewport editor schema and invented fixture (viewport_editor.schema.yaml).
REQUIRED_ROOT requires schema_version, deliverable_id, package_id, scope_item, objectives, viewport_status, and viewport_session.
REQUIRED_DEFS enumerates required schema $defs including CameraState, CommandIntent, ProfessionalBoundary, ViewportSession, ViewportStatus, and ViewportDiagnosticCode.
REQUIRED_PRIMITIVES include node, pipe_run, bend_arc, branch_symbol, valve_symbol, flange_symbol, reducer_symbol, expansion_joint_symbol, and support_symbol.
REQUIRED_COMMANDS include create_node, connect_pipe_run, insert_bend, insert_branch_symbol, insert_component_symbol, select_entities, and clear_selection.
REQUIRED_DIAGNOSTIC_CLASSES include SOLVE_BLOCKING, RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, ASSUMPTION_WARNING, NONLINEAR_WARNING, IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING, UNIT_WARNING, and GUI_STATE_WARNING.
FORBIDDEN_FIXTURE_TERMS bar ASME, B31, B31J, allowable-stress-table, SIF-table, vendor-catalog-value, real-secret, code-compliant, certified, and sealed from the fixture.
Viewport schema must be draft 2020-12, additionalProperties False, with no default key anywhere.
Viewport schema constants: deliverable_id DEL-07-01, package_id PKG-07, scope_item SOW-020, objectives contains OBJ-006.
ViewportStatus declares frontend_app_shell TBD, viewport_renderer Three_js_runtime_integration_TBD, durable_state_mutation application_service_command_intents_only, and command_transport TBD.
ViewportStatus transient_state_policy states camera, hover, selection, drag, and snap are not persisted project payload.
ProfessionalBoundary requires human_review_required const True and all software_makes_*_claim consts False.
CommandIntent requires intent_id, command_type, target_ref, payload_refs, unit_policy, reversible, validation_state, diagnostic_refs, and provenance.
CommandIntent unit_policy const is unit_aware_domain_validation_required.
Viewport fixture sets deliverable_id DEL-07-01, frontend_app_shell TBD, and durable_state_mutation application_service_command_intents_only.
Fixture interaction_state active_tool is connect_pipe_run and view_primitives[0]/[1] are node and pipe_run.
Fixture command_intents[0] has validation_state pending_service_validation and unit_policy unit_aware_domain_validation_required.
Fixture diagnostics[0] class is GUI_STATE_WARNING and provenance redistribution_status is invented_non_engineering_example with privacy_classification invented_public_example.
Test asserts no FORBIDDEN_FIXTURE_TERMS appear anywhere in the viewport fixture text.
